exposure: Mode of delivery (cesarean section vs. normal delivery)
outcome: Functionality (measured by Time Up and Go test)
cohort: 72 postpartum women (36 cesarean section, 36 normal delivery)
finding: While cesarean deliveries were associated with higher pelvic floor muscle strength, normal deliveries were associated with better functionality in the immediate puerperium.
mod_finding: Cesarean deliveries were associated with higher pelvic floor muscle strength, while normal deliveries showed better functionality.
